title: Polar normalization of a vector Riesz density and push-forward to ℝ^P (parent steps 4–9)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (c : Covector (Euclid P) n ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (μ₀ : Measure U) (ν : U → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), IsOpen U → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖) → Measurable ν → (∀ K : Set U, IsCompact K → IntegrableOn ν K μ₀) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable β μ ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, ‖β x‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ξ x (β x) = 1) ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, ∫ x, inner ℝ (c (ω x)) (ν x) ∂μ₀ = ∫ x, ξ x (ω x) ∂μ
